note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. All the divisions were uncontested and the Fermanagh Herald prints the full nomination list; Kinawley was left vacant and is not recorded (Fermanagh Herald, 4 June 1955, p. 8). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Corrygloss' to Corraglass (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Corraglass; the rounds were filed as Corryglass (1924, 1927, 1936, 1952); Corraglass (1930, 1933, 1939, 1946, 1961, 1964); Conyglass (1949); Corrygloss (1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Corrygloss', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (corrygloss) answers with a redirect to this one.
